title: 第10章 事儿该拒就拒
content_zh:
“哈哈哈，陆大人和丁大人二位赏脸，里面请。”方则言见二人抵达醉花楼门口，第一时间就迎了过来。

    魏乐府依旧板着脸，陆翰墨反倒是游刃有余地寒暄着：“方公子邀请，我们自然得来赴宴了。”

    别看陆翰墨热情，要是没那份孝敬，他理都不理方则言。

    跟这种豪门子弟交往，对方拿你当资源，你自然也得把对方当跳板。

    真要有什么真心对真心，被坑死都不知道。

    随后，方则言前头带路，三人一同进了醉花楼的包厢内。

    不多时，酒菜就上了桌，魏乐府也不客气地下了筷。

    然后他就发现这些酒菜真不一般，居然还是药膳。

    效果虽然不如大药，但整体而言要强过普通的食物。

    “丁大人很喜欢醉花楼的花团宴。”方则言看着魏乐府风卷残云的清空桌面，也不恼怒，反而笑着说道：“来人，再上一桌。”

    他就怕魏乐府来了之后跟泥胎一样坐着，软硬不吃才是最棘手的。

    “守成啊，被孟惟那老货饿久了。”陆翰墨却是跟着应声说道：“方公子你是不知道。”

    “第一天点卯后，连田大人见他这么吃都震惊哩。”

    他这话是在点方则言，告诉他田牧川也非常看重魏乐府，并且魏乐府资质上不差，只是被压着了。

    “丁大人好本事啊，再上两桌。”方则言当下也明白了陆翰墨的意思，就是得加钱了。

    “让方公子破费了。”魏乐府见对方明白的差不多了，这才顺势开口：“只要你不是来给四方武馆当说客的，都好说。”

    “丁大人能赏脸，什么破费不破费的，那是它的荣幸。”方则言恭维着说道。

    在魏乐府开口的时候，他就松了一口气，知道这件事稳了。

    有时候送礼，不在于能不能送得起，而在于有没有门路以及礼能不能送出去。

    “听说，沈千钧要回来了。”魏乐府忽地说道。

    方则言听到这话，也是愣了一下，他没想到魏乐府居然知道。

    魏乐府其实并不知道，只是随口诈一句而已，猜中了那就可以提前布局。

    猜错了也就那样，又没有损失。

    “这我不是很清楚，自打他去了州府就没联系了。”方则言不动声色地表示不知道。

    方则言和沈千钧有利益往来，要回来的消息他也是今天下午刚刚知道的。

    他心里也犯嘀咕，这‘丁守成’看来是真和四方武馆杠上了，连风闻司都用在了沈千钧的身上。
content_en:
"Hahaha, Mr. Lu and Mr. Ding would like to express their respect to you. Please come inside." Fang Zeyan saw the two of them arriving at the entrance of Zuihua Building and greeted them as soon as possible.

    Wei Yuefu still had a straight face, but Lu Hanmo greeted him calmly: "Master Fang invites us, so of course we have to come to the banquet."

    Despite Lu Hanmo's enthusiasm, if he didn't have that filial piety, he would have ignored Fang Zeyan.

    When you associate with a kid from such a wealthy family, the other person will use you as a resource, and you will naturally have to use the other person as a springboard.

    If you really want to be sincere, you won't even know if you are tricked to death.

    Afterwards, Fang Zeyan led the way, and the three of them entered the private room of Zuihua Tower together.

    Not long after, the food and wine were served on the table, and Wei Yuefu took down his chopsticks without ceremony.

    Then he discovered that these wines and dishes were really extraordinary. They were actually medicinal foods.

    Although the effect is not as good as big medicine, it is overall stronger than ordinary food.

    "Master Ding likes the flower banquet at Zuihualou very much." Fang Zeyan looked at Wei Yuefu's empty table in the wind, but he was not angry. Instead, he said with a smile: "Come here, put another table on the table."

    He was afraid that when Wei Yuefu came, he would just sit there like a mud tire. The most difficult thing was not to eat softly or hard.

    "Shou Cheng, I've been starved by that old guy Meng Wei for a long time." Lu Hanmo responded and said, "Young Master Fang, you don't know."

    "After the meal was ordered on the first day, Mr. Tian was shocked to see him eating like this."

    What he said was to point out Fang Zeyan, telling him that Tian Muchuan also valued Wei Yuefu very much, and that Wei Yuefu's qualifications were not bad, but he was suppressed.

    "Master Ding, you are very capable. Let's serve two more tables." Fang Zeyan immediately understood what Lu Hanmo meant, which was that he had to pay more.

    "It's costing Mr. Fang a lot of money." Wei Yuefu saw that the other party had almost understood, so he took advantage of the situation and said, "As long as you are not here to be a lobbyist for Sifang Martial Arts School, it will be easy to talk to."

    "It's an honor for Mr. Ding to be able to reward you, even if it costs nothing." Fang Zeyan said complimentarily.

    When Wei Yuefu spoke, he breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that the matter was settled.

    Sometimes giving a gift is not about whether you can afford it, but whether you have the access and whether the gift can be sent out.

    "I heard that Shen Qianjun is coming back." Wei Yuefu said suddenly.

    Fang Zeyan was stunned for a moment when he heard this. He didn't expect that Wei Yuefu actually knew.

    Wei Yuefu actually didn't know, he just said a casual lie. If he guessed correctly, he could make plans in advance.

    If you guess wrong, that's it, there is no loss.

    "I'm not very clear about this. I haven't contacted him since he went to the state capital." Fang Zeyan said calmly that he didn't know.

    Fang Zeyan and Shen Qianjun had an interest in each other, and he just learned about his return this afternoon.

    He also murmured in his heart that this 'Ding Shoucheng' seemed to have really come into conflict with the Sifang Martial Arts School, and even the Rumor Department used it on Shen Qianjun.
title_en: Chapter 10: Say no if you have to say no
